title: A render that completes can still be wrong — a short scene clip freezes, and a black-frame check does not see it
summary: On the SpiderVideo stitch renderer, a scene clip shorter than its durationInSeconds renders WITHOUT error: exit 0, status completed, h264, the requested dimensions, duration and frame count — and the missing seconds are a frozen copy of the clip's last frame. Measured on the live worker image (v1.6.0): a 2 s clip declared as 5 s gave 150 frames at 5.000 s, metadata identical to a correct control, with frames 61-150 (60%) frozen and ZERO black, so luma/black checks pass it. Only frame-to-frame difference caught it. A scene URL that 404s is the opposite case — it fails the job (exit 1, no file) — so 'a missing asset renders black' is FALSE. Measure pixels before reporting success: verify-video.py preflight predicts it (scene-N-length), render catches it (frozen).
references: Measured 2026-09-23 on martinshein/spideriq-worker-spidervideo:v1.6.0 (the live worker image), render-from-config.ts in a throwaway container: control 5 s clip / 5 s declared -> 0 black, 0 frozen; 2 s clip / 5 s declared -> exit 0, h264 1080x1920, 150 frames, 5.000 s, YAVG 126.9 throughout, 90 frames with frame-to-frame YDIF < 0.5 (frames 61-150); 404 scene -> curl 22 x3, 'Asset preparation failed', exit 1, no output file
scripts/verify-video.py render on the same two files: control PASS; short clip FAIL 'frozen 1.97-5.00 s (scene 1)' with codec, dimensions, duration and black all PASS
workers/SpiderVideo/remotion-app/src/VideoStitcher/index.tsx — each scene is a Sequence of round(durationInSeconds x 30) frames over an OffthreadVideo of the clip, on a black background
workers/SpiderVideo/remotion-app/src/lib/asset-manager.ts — prepareJob fails the job when any scene does not download (the 404 case)
SpiderIQ card SC-469 (2026-09-23) — the brief's '404 renders black with exit 0' premise, measured false and replaced by this
